sentence: This project studies the ethical questions that come up when choosing machine learning training methods, such as environmental cost, labor practices, and data quality.
This project builds a way to make strong, lightweight bone implants from carbon fiber polymers using printing, heat, pressure, and computer models.
This project tests whether changes in behavior alter the sensory feedback an animal receives and so modify the brain in weakly electric fish.
This project builds a framework in which AI helps discover numerical linear algebra algorithms and proof software checks that they are correct.
This project builds a way to send genome editing tools into the brain without viral vectors using peptides that cross the blood brain barrier.
This project studies water in coastal California watersheds, looking at water quality, aquatic habitat, and human effects.
This project builds tools that automatically adapt software defenses to the setting where the software runs and remove unused code.
This project builds imaging methods that recover the full range of plausible images that fit indirect and noisy measurements instead of a single image.
This project uses deep learning to build statistical tests and methods for survival analysis, causal inference, and prediction intervals.
This project studies how climate change affects trout fisheries in the Mountain West and how people and managers respond to those changes.
This project builds a compiler, a verifier, and a memory management system that let quantum programs look up data by address in software.
This project studies gravity, black holes, and the quantum structure of spacetime.
This project builds a deep learning model that helps power grids handle natural disasters and attacks by predicting outages and reconfiguring the network.
This project supports a conference where researchers share work on bioinformatics, computational systems biology, and biomedical and health informatics.
This project studies the internal structure of horizontal branch stars, especially subdwarf B stars, by measuring their distances, radii, and masses.
